name: dropthing-root
description: DropThing - Instant PIN-Based Cloud File & Text Bridge

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
